description: This file defines a custom Android View class 'MyDrawView' that provides drawing functionality via touch input. It manages a bitmap canvas and allows users to draw, clear, and handle touch events for freehand drawing.

classes.name: MyDrawView
classes.description: A custom View that enables freehand drawing using touch input, managing its own bitmap and canvas for rendering.

methods.name: MyDrawView
methods.description: Constructor initializing paint objects and path for drawing.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles view size changes by creating or resizing the bitmap and canvas.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the bitmap and current path onto the canvas.

methods.name: touch_start
methods.description: Begins a new drawing path at specified coordinates.

methods.name: touch_move
methods.description: Adds a quadratic Bezier curve to the path based on movement, for smooth lines.

methods.name: touch_up
methods.description: Completes the current path and commits it to the bitmap canvas.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to draw, move, and lift finger, updating the path accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Erases the current drawing by clearing the bitmap and invalidates view.
